Ok for the money. The phone functions great, but I agree with other reviews in regards to the screen has burn in.

Great replacement. The screen on my old pixel 3a xl cracked and it was cheaper to buy a replacement than repair the screen. Was worried I might get a crappy refurbished model, as some reviewers purported they did, nbut it was like new when I got it delivered. Happy with the purchase as it has worked great so far. No problems at all.

Like new! Make sure you look at seller ratings.. I was pretty nervous about ordering a renewed phone from Amazon because of all the mixed reviews. I learned that Amazon lists these phones from multiple refurbishers, and you are able to see the ratings of each one before you buy it. I went with "bayshine Trading" and bought 2 Pixel 3a XL's, both of which were like-new with no scratches on the screen and hardly any visible signs of use on the back. The battery also lasts the entire day with no issues. Don't just go with the cheapest seller, make sure you check out the seller ratings. Even if you aren't satisfied, you still have a 90 day return window.

Do not buy refurbished phones. [[VIDEOID:2a0ad3a487f96c30e5ffa0f360504b8]] I had a pixel 3axl that I loved, had it for years... then the screen broke. I decided to "save money" by buying a refurbished phone to replace it. Big mistake! I bought this thing and within days it began to freeze up, randomly crash, and was not reliable at all. People... please share yourselves the disappointment and just buy new. Thank you. I give this -10 stars.
Solid used/refurbished phone. All works as the first google pixel I dropped and broke the screen

Refurb- works fine, looks like new, gets the latest Android updates. 1) I bought the refurb version; great battery life, perfect screen, no scratches, looks like new. 2) I needed to update from a Android phone that no longer got updates, which are very needed for security. The 3axl is listed to get updates for at least the next year or two. 3) Lots of screen real estate; much easier to use than smaller phones. 4) Good wifi sensitivity, works with weak signals.

Scratched up screen from BuySPRY. Bought my phone from BuySPRY and the phone arrived in a generic box with very noticeable scratches on the screen. The phone might as well have been used, but at least it was unlocked. I'm getting a screen protector to see if that will mask the scratches at least a little bit.
Like brand new. No screen scratches. Battery holds a decent charge. It came with Android 12 already on it. Quick shipping.

Defective screen... Phone looks fine from outside and came with a 3rd party charger. Did not come with a sim removal tool. The phone has a defective screen, one can clearly see multiple vertical black strips in the backgroud. Seller offered me a $15 partial refund for a defective screen if i want to keep the phone... what a joke and waste of time.

Dead on Arrival, otherwise great phone. The particular phone we got was dead on arrival, but when we sent it back and got a different one, it works great. LONG battery life, as fast as any newer phone, with a great touchscreen and everything a person could want in a phone. I don't have good things to say about the particular seller we bought from, but the phone is great!

Dirty Phone. I can say that the phone didn't go through right refurbishing process because it came very dirty like it was freshly taken out of its case and dirts are everywhere, deep seated on the corners and linings of the phone. The display has yellowish tinge, I wonder if that's normal for pixel 3a/3axl phones. The box is very generic brown box with not enough bubble wrappings considering that it was shipped to the Philippines. I have purchased pixel 3 from the same shop The Gadget Deals before and I was satisfied because it came in a very decent and secured phone box packaging and it was neat, this time the shop disappointed me.
Pixel 3A XL. I like this phone so much I bought it again, after my screen broke on my old pixel 3A XL, I bought the same phone.

I think you should go with Samsung Galaxy. This phone has a lot of things wrong with it I bought it rebuilt so if you're not touching the screen within 3 seconds to 4 seconds it'll go to sleep on you even if you change the settings it doesn't work like it's supposed to I really don't like this phone.

Very Impressed. As described, looks and works like new. I usually can only afford low end phones so I thought I would take a chance on a used mid-range phone. Battery lasts well over a day and the display is bright and clear with no burn-in. Can't wait to try the camera.

GOOD INEXPENSIVE. Fast processor. Good screen. Reasonable Fingerprint reader. Good camera.

The Google Pixel 3A XL is a VERY physically slippery phone, so I strongly suggest a case with some texture. Also, I'd suggest a screen protector - 9H rating would be good. (None of this should be taken as a negative to the company, it's the nature of the business and the product itself.) As I said above, I will be buying with Hybrid IT again. Definitely.
Outstanding value. Great phone on a budget, super clear screen and great battery life for a top notch phone. And since it is a pixel it still gets updates and can beta Android 12.

I got the right version this time only that it doesnt come with a fast charger.
